question: Why do Astra Pro ARC review sessions report out of space when the user does not see this with Sol Pro?
measured_scope: This task only; no matched Sol session or clean-environment comparison was measured.

official_documentation_checked.finding: The documented default for Pro/Business/Enterprise is 32 GiB disk, with resource rows organized by plan. The table does not specify an Astra-versus-Sol disk allocation.
official_documentation_checked.limit: This public Codex Cloud table does not establish the exact provisioning or shared backing storage of the present ChatGPT tool session.

official_documentation_checked.finding: Model guidance distinguishes reasoning, speed and cost; the inspected page contains no disk or storage allocation specification.

conclusion: Measured filesystem byte and inode exhaustion explains the failures here. Model-specific quota or cleanup differences are not established.
hypotheses_not_verified: Different initial workspace fullness or environment reuse
Different extraction, runtime-copy, temporary-file, or cleanup behavior
Different provisioning or routing between sessions
next_comparison: For a controlled comparison, capture df -B1 and df -i plus the same archive preflight at session start and after extraction in Astra and Sol on the same packet. Record namespaces, directory footprint and whether extraction is full or selective.
preventive_action: Use the already-bundled metadata-only preflight before full extraction. The supplied archive needs 11,768 new file/directory entries and an estimated 219,590,656 allocation bytes before reserves; normal writable storage fails both budgets. Continue using the already-retained working session instead of repeating extraction.
